ModMetaData.name: Rimworld Statistics
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
全セーブ・全コロニーを通した通算のプレイ統計を、タイトル画面から表示します。MOD 導入前のセーブ（1.5〜1.7）も読み取り専用で取り込みます。
Shows lifetime play statistics across all saves and colonies from the title screen. Includes optional source-audited statistics for Hospitality, Recruitment, Dubs Bad Hygiene and Smart Apparel Upgrade with no separate statistics addons. Saves made before the mod was installed (1.5 to 1.7) are imported read-only.
